summary: output.links shows clickable buttons with title, url and an optional icon; URLs can use step output such as steps['launch-job'].output.data.url, and multiple links are allowed.
questions: How do I add a link to the AAP job in self-service output?
Can I set an icon on output links?
How do I add multiple buttons to a template's output?

answer_card.title: Link to the launched job in template output
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
output:
  links:
    - title: View job in Ansible Automation Platform
      url: ${{ steps['launch-job'].output.data.url }}
    - title: RHEL documentation
      url: https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_enterprise_linux/
      icon: docs
```
Each link takes `title`, `url` and an optional `icon`.
